verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a comprehensive public REST API. It covers private-key, OAuth and public-key authentication with scopes, endpoints such as create campaign and create event, cursor pagination and sparse fieldsets, rate-limit headers, an importable OpenAPI spec and Postman collection, and official SDKs in Python, PHP, Ruby and Node. Its llms.txt explicitly states the product is accessible headlessly through its public APIs so AI agents can read, write and act on data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage (community evidence only touches the JS snippet), and a developer-site llms.txt (probe returned 404).
